# fortisase_auth_users (Data Source)

User Resource API V2 for FortiSASE.
fortisase_auth_users is deprecated. Please use fortisase_auth_user instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fortisase_auth_user" "example" {
  primary_key = "<your_value>"
}
```
